title: INTERNATIONAL MANUFACTURING COMPANY: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (40,986 affected)
summary: THERE IS SOME CONCERN THAT THE SNAPS WHICH LOCK THE BUCKLE TO THE CROTCH STRAP MAY PULL THROUGH THE WEBBING AFTER CONTINUOUS USE.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:CARBURETOR:UNKNOWN TYPE (106,651 affected)
summary: THE CARBURETOR FUEL INLET HOUSING PLUG IN THE SIDE OF THE CARBURETOR MAY COME OUT.

title: AURORA CARS, LIMITED: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:CONTROL ARM (31 affected)
summary: ON INVOLVED VEHICLES, THE REAR AXLE HUB UPRIGHT, WHICH CONNECTS THE HUB CARRIER TO THE LOWER CONTROL ARM, MAY PIVOT SLIGHTLY. THIS CONDITION WILL OCCUR IF THE BOLTS ATTACHING THE UPRIGHT TO THE HUB CARRIER ARE NOT KEPT TIGHT, COMBINED WITH SEVERE CORNERING CONDITIONS. THIS PIVOTING CONDITION WILL CAUSE THE BOLTS TO ELONGATE THE HOLES OF THE UPRIGHT, RESULTING IN REAR WHEEL VIBRATION. THIS WILL EVENTUALLY LEAD TO HUB CARRIER BREAKAGE.

title: DRAG: STRUCTURE:BODY (3,032 affected)
summary: THE POSSIBILITY EXISTS THAT THE FENDER TRIM PART MAY CRACK DURING MOUNTING OR AFTER CONTINUOUS USE AND MAY FALL OFF AND LODGE ITSELF WITHIN THE MOTORCYCLE.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: POWER TRAIN:AXLE ASSEMBLY (1,347 affected)
summary: ON SOME OF THE INVOLVED VEHICLES, THE KNURLED NUT, PART OF THE RUBBER MOUNT ASSEMBLY WHICH SUPPORTS THE DIFFERENTIAL, MAY HAVE BEEN CRACKED DUE TO OVER-TORQUING OF THE FINAL DRIVE ATTACHING BOLT. THIS BOLT MAY BECOME LOOSE, AND CONTINUED OPERATION MAY CAUSE IT TO FALL OUT.

title: ARMSTRONG RUBBER CO.: TIRES:SIDEWALL (2,306 affected)
summary: THE SIDEWALL RUBBER MAY NOT HAVE ADEQUATE RESISTANCE TO OZONE AND WEATHER CRACKING IN A SMALL AREA AROUND THE TIRE AND ABOVE THE RAISED WHITE LETTERING. THIS CONDITION COULD LEAD TO CRACKS IN THE SIDEWALLS, AND IF IT CONTINUES UNDETECTED, A LOSS OF AIR COULD RESULT.

title: LEE TIRE & RUBBER CO.: TIRES:SIDEWALL (11,000 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED TIRES MAY CONTAIN LESS RUBBER INSULATION BETWEEN THE INNER EXTREMITY OF THE BEAD BUNDLE AND WIRE PLY STOCK THAN NEEDED. THE WIRE PLY STOCK COULD SHEAR WHEN CONTACT IS MADE WITH THE BEAD BUNDLE.

title: MITSUBISHI MANUFACTURING AMER: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK (1,849 affected)
summary: ON SOME OF THE INVOLVED VEHICLES, THE FUEL FILLER HOSE MAY BREAK IN A REAR-END COLLISION. THE FAILURE OF THE HOSE AND RESULTING FUEL LEAKAGE IS NOT IN COMPLIANCE WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 301, "FUEL SYSTEM INTEGRITY".

title: General Motors, LLC: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER:MOTOR (5,316 affected)
summary: DURING WINDSHIELD WIPER OPERATION, THE NOISE SUPPRESION CAPACITOR IN THE WIPER MOTOR RELAY MAY OVERHEAT.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE (155 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN VEHICLES, A PROTECTIVE RUBBER GROMMET MAY HAVE BEEN OMITTED FROM AN OPENING IN THE METAL BATTERY COMPARTMENT. THESE VEHICLES HAVE THE 12-VOLT ELECTRICAL WIRES PASSING THROUGH A SHARP EDGED OPENING IN THE METAL BATTERY COMPARTMENT THAT, WITHOUT WARNING COULD CUT THROUGH THE WIRE INSULATION CAUSING AN ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:MATTRESS (800 affected)
summary: THE MATTRESSES INCLUDED WITH CERTAIN VEHICLES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 302, "FLAMMABILITY OF INTERIOR MATERIALS". THE MATTRESS COVERS BURN AT A FASTER RATE THAN IS CONSIDERED SAFE.

title: Gillig, LLC: STEERING:COLUMN COUPLING (66 affected)
summary: THE STEERING COLUMN COUPLING, CONNECTING THE STEERING SHAFT TO GEAR MAY HAVE BEEN MACHINED OVERSIZED. THE INSIDE DIAMETER OF THE COUPLING MAY BE TOO LARGE WHICH MAY LEAD TO COUPLING FAILURE.
